kind: default-off development observation; not performance acceptance
headless: reject a frame cap; preserve deterministic unpaced fixed steps
pacingPolicy: minimum owner-loop admission interval: ceil(Stopwatch.Frequency / fps); first admission immediate; late work rebases from actual admission, never catch-up bursts
waiting: Thread.Sleep slices at most 8ms, final <=1ms uses bounded SpinWait calls with repeated time/cancellation checks; no timer resolution change or GPU waits
scope: wall loop durations including synchronous waits and observation overhead; not pure CPU time
admissionTimestamp: actual Stopwatch timestamp captured by FramePacer; separately copied into loop report v2
intervalMeaning: owner-loop admission cap is not physical display synchronization or a guarantee of average/1%-low FPS
simulation: unchanged supplied monotonic wall-clock delta and existing fixed-step/catch-up policy
overflow: first prefix retained and omissions explicit; no full-run percentiles
gpuEvidence: no change to prior v3 domain evidence or current/resolved slots
remaining: full regression and final same-source cohorts
